english.title: Fail to comply with duty to give notices to persons with significant control in a company
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and failed]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and who was in default by failing]_

without reasonable excuse to comply with the duty under section 790D of the Act to

(C)_[take reasonable steps to find out if there was anyone who was a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company and, if so, to identify them]_
(D)_[give notice as required by that section to anyone whom it knew or had reasonable cause to believe to be a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity in relation to it]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 790D and 790F of the Companies Act 2006.
